content: Recharts is the default pick for React charting in 2026 (48.9M weekly downloads, highest of any React chart lib), good enough for standard bar/line charts (fixture ticker, price history, points trend). visx (Airbnb, D3 primitives, ~15KB) gives full control for custom viz but steeper learning curve. Nivo gives polished defaults with more chart types out of the box. Recommendation: Recharts for standard charts; skip visx/nivo unless a specific chart type Recharts can't do well is needed.
